archetypes.name: dyn-resume-env
archetypes.rationale: Resume route env rehydration now affects route argv, stdout, and source-env refresh.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 0 resume route flow. Check that ISSUE_NUMBER and REPO are recovered before design route runs, that live env values still win over route-state sidecars, and that resume routes refresh source-env.sh before emitting ROUTE. Pay special attention to missing SESSION_ID or non-numeric ISSUE_NUMBER failures and to non-resume route behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
